lines: * Request parameters are no longer trimmed while a request is parsed. `Piwik\API\Request::getRequestArrayFromString()` used to apply `trim((string) $value)` to every non-array parameter, so leading and trailing whitespace in values such as a `label` or a segment operand is now preserved, and scalars keep their type. As a consequence a boolean passed through `Piwik\API\Request::processRequest()` no longer arrives as `'1'`/`''`: a parameter read with `Piwik\Common::getRequestVar($name, $default, 'string')` or `Piwik\Request::getStringParameter()` falls back to its default instead. Pass a string, or read it with `Piwik\Request::getBoolParameter()`, which accepts real booleans.

* The `SitesManager.getImageTrackingCode` API method now requires view access to the given site, matching `SitesManager.getJavascriptTag`. Its parameters are typed as well, so `idSite` must be an integer and `forceMatomoEndpoint` a boolean — the latter is now read with `Piwik\Request::getBoolParameter()`, which understands `0`, `1`, `true` and `false` and silently falls back to `false` for anything else, where previously any truthy value enabled it.

* The legacy Transitions renderer has been removed together with the JavaScript globals it defined, `Piwik_Transitions`, `Piwik_Transitions_Canvas` and `Piwik_Transitions_Util`. Use the `Transitions.TransitionsReport` Vue component instead, or `DataTable_RowActions_Transitions.launchForUrl()`, which is unchanged and still opens the report for a URL. `Piwik_Transitions_Model` and `Piwik_Transitions_Ajax` remain, without the renderer-only members `htmlLoaded()`, `getShareInGroupTooltip()` and `callTransitionsController()`. The controller action `index.php?module=Transitions&action=renderPopover`, which rendered the removed markup, and the `@internal` API method `Transitions.getTranslations`, which only supplied its labels, have been removed with it, along with the `Piwik_Transitions_Translations` global that template defined. `Piwik_Transitions_Ajax.callApi()` no longer falls back to `Piwik_Popover.showError()` when no `setErrorCallback()` was registered: an API error is dropped and the request's callback never runs, so a caller that wants errors surfaced must register one.

+* The `Marketplace.searchPlugins` controller action now returns only the fields the plugin cards in the Marketplace list render. The version history, shop details, screenshots, support links, authors, changelog and activity it used to include are served per plugin by the new `Marketplace.getPluginDetails` action instead, which the plugin details modal requests when it opens. Each version of every plugin carried its own rendered readme and FAQ HTML, so the list response was over a megabyte on a typical install. The `plugins` template variable the `Marketplace.GetPremiumFeatures` and `Marketplace.GetNewPlugins` widgets pass to their templates has been reduced the same way.

+* An enriched plugin's `consumer.license` is now the license `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Consumer::getConsumerPluginLicenses()` reports rather than the copy the Marketplace embedded in the plugin list, so it agrees with the `hasExceededLicense` and `isMissingLicense` flags beside it. The copy embedded in the plugin list is only rewritten for an installed plugin, but the flags themselves are derived from the consumer response for every plugin, so a plugin the Marketplace suppresses a trial for keeps that suppression: a `consumer.license` that is not a license row is honoured as-is. This also changes what `Marketplace.searchPlugins` sends to the browser, since `consumer` is one of the fields the plugin cards keep. `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Plugins\InvalidLicenses` classifies the admin-page license banners from this value, so those banners and the plugin cards can no longer disagree; `createAccount` and `startFreeTrial` now clear its cache alongside the Marketplace cache, as `saveLicenseKey` already did.

+* `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Api\Client::getConsumer()` and `isValidConsumer()` no longer send a request when no license key is set, returning `null` and `false` directly. The Marketplace answers `403` to an unauthenticated `consumer` request and can only answer `false` to `consumer/validate`, so the results are unchanged.

+* A plugin that the Marketplace's update check reports as updatable is now marked updatable when the Marketplace plugin enriches it, without separately resolving that plugin's full info first. The rows the plugins admin page and the update notification email render are now resolved from the cached plugin and theme lists by `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Api\Client::getInfoOfPluginsHavingUpdate()`, falling back to a per plugin info request only for a plugin neither list holds; a plugin that cannot be resolved either way is still dropped. On a live instance the resulting set is unchanged, because the Marketplace serves info for every plugin it lists.

* The new `DragHandle` Vue component in CoreHome renders the standard 6-dot drag-handle icon, for use inside `DraggableList` rows. The `DraggableList` component's `handle` option now also works with real browser drags, which retarget `dragstart` to the draggable element (previously the handle was only recognised in synthetically dispatched events).

* The new `closeTooltips()` helper in CoreHome closes the jQuery UI tooltips bound to a selector's elements, including pending delayed shows — for cases where no mouse event will fire that would close them, eg. once an HTML5 drag has started.

* A new `#[Piwik\Http\JsonResponse]` attribute can be applied to a plugin controller action to declare that it returns a JSON response. When present, Matomo (re-)sends the `Content-Type: application/json` header after the action has returned, so it can no longer be overwritten by output produced while the action builds its response (for example a rendered `Piwik\View`, which sends `text/html`). An action using the attribute must return the JSON string, must not send the header itself, and must not emit output (`echo`/`print`/`flush`) or call `exit`/`die` before returning — otherwise the response headers are committed first and the JSON `Content-Type` cannot be applied. The attribute is not inherited: a subclass overriding a JSON action must re-declare it. These requirements are enforced by PHPStan rules.

* The `SearchInput` component exported from `CoreHome` gained a `focused` prop and a `blur()` method: setting `focused` to `true` moves focus to the inner input and calling `blur()` on the component removes it, both of which were previously impossible because binding `v-focus-if` or an element ref to the component targeted its non-focusable wrapper. `CoreHome.QuickAccess` now renders this component instead of duplicating its markup, so its search field is no longer a separate `input` that happens to carry the same classes. Quick search also runs off the field's value rather than off keystrokes, so text that arrives without one (a pasted term, an IME candidate committed with the mouse) now searches too, and keys that belong to an open IME candidate window no longer act on the result list.

+* The new `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Api\Client::PLUGIN_LIST_CACHE_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS` is how long a Marketplace plugin or theme list stays cached, separately from `CACHE_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS`, which is unchanged and still governs every other response. It is deliberately longer than the interval the new hourly `Marketplace.warmCacheEntries` task refills those lists at, so a visitor almost never pays for the requests the Marketplace overview needs.

+* Because the plugin list, the details modal and the new `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Plugins::getPluginInfoPreferringList()` all answer out of those cached lists, anything the Marketplace itself authors — the description, readme and FAQ, screenshots, authors, activity and version list, plus the `priceFrom` and `missingRequirements` computed from them — is held for ninety minutes rather than one hour, and only for the unfiltered, default-sorted lists a new hourly scheduled task refills — the ones the overview asks for. A search, a different sort or a purchase type nothing warms keeps the one hour timeout it had. The new hourly `Marketplace.warmCacheEntries` task refills those lists on the hour, so the extra thirty minutes is headroom for a missed cron run rather than staleness a page normally shows. Anything derived from local state or a separately cached response is unchanged: `isInstalled`, `isActivated`, `canBeUpdated`, and everything about the consumer's license.

+* `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Consumer::getConsumerPluginLicenses()` is new and returns the consumer's license for each plugin it covers, keyed by plugin name. `Plugins::enrichPluginInformation()` uses it so that `hasExceededLicense`, `isMissingLicense` and `isEligibleForFreeTrial` reflect the current license rather than the copy the Marketplace embedded in a plugin list that may be a few hours old. A response that lists no license for a plugin is treated as authoritative, so a license that is revoked takes effect as soon as the consumer response refreshes. The embedded copy is only used when the consumer request could not be made at all, so an instance that cannot reach the Marketplace behaves as it did before.

+* A user can clear the whole Marketplace cache from the "check for updates" action, and saving a license key, starting a trial, creating an account, opening the subscription overview or applying a core update all clear it too.

+* The new `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Api\Client::getUpdateSummariesOfPluginsHavingUpdate()` returns what the Marketplace reports about a set of plugins' updates, keyed by plugin name, from a single `checkUpdates` request. `getInfoOfPluginsHavingUpdate()` remains available for callers that need each plugin's full info, at the cost of one further request per plugin having an update.

+* The new hourly `Marketplace.warmCacheEntries` scheduled task refetches the three overview lists the Marketplace page reads from, and `Tasks::clearAllCacheEntries()` now refills them immediately after its daily flush rather than leaving the next visitor to pay for them. This costs the Marketplace three requests an hour per installation that has the Marketplace enabled: the responses carry an eight day max-age, but every Marketplace call is a POST and is answered as a CDN miss, so each refill reaches the origin rather than a cache.

+* The new `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Plugins::getPluginInfoPreferringList()` returns one plugin's full information, answering from an already cached overview list when it holds that plugin and falling back to `Api\Client::getPluginInfo()` otherwise. `Marketplace.getPluginDetails` uses it, so opening a details modal on a warm cache costs no Marketplace request. The supporting `Api\Client::findInCachedOverviewLists()` searches only the lists that are already cached, so a cold cache never turns a single plugin lookup into a download of a whole catalogue.

+* `Piwik\Plugins\Marketplace\Environment::getPhpVersion()` now returns the PHP version the web server runs when it is called from the CLI, having recorded it under the new `Environment::OPTION_WEB_PHP_VERSION` option whenever a request serves a page. The PHP version is part of every Marketplace cache key, so on a host whose CLI and web PHP builds differ the scheduled cache warming previously filled entries no page could ever read. It falls back to the running version until a page has recorded one.
